2677.title: Stale child failure outcome after late acceptance
2677.rootCauseOneLine: Thread command timeouts become terminal failures, while the outcome batch keeps stale and duplicate child entries.
2677.proposedFix: Treat command_timeout as uncertain delivery during thread settlement and deduplicate batch entries by child thread ID.
2677.caveats: The focused test verified the late accepted state, but it did not wait for a later normal completion.
